newsitem.title: INDIA: Blast in India's Kashmir, several feared dead--PTI.
newsitem.headline: Blast in India's Kashmir, several feared dead--PTI.

text.p: Several people were feared killed on Saturday when a bomb exploded in a bus in India's Jammu and Kashmir state, the Press Trust of India (PTI) news agency said.
It said three buses were engulfed in flames when the bomb exploded in Jammu, the winter capital of the state.
PTI said more details of the blast were not immediately available.
The blast occurred on the second day of crucial talks between senior Indian and Pakistani diplomats in New Delhi, the first in three years between the bitter rivals.

The last round of talks in January 1994 collapsed over Kashmir, where a separatist Moslem revolt has been raging since 1980 in the part of the Himalayan territory controlled by India. Pakistan rules one-third of the Kashmir valley and India the rest.
PTI said separatist guerrillas and security forces exchanged fire earlier on Saturday at Bohrikadal, a suburb of Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir's summer capital.
